name: SDガンダム ジージェネレーション エターナル

detail.description:
The latest installment in the "SD Gundam G Generation" series is coming to smartphones!

Over 940 mobile suits and characters from 98 Gundam series throughout history are gathered!

【Game Features】
■Number of Participating Series: 98 Series, Over 940 Mobile Suits
Over 940 mobile suits from throughout the history of Gundam are playable.
Combine characters and mobile suits to create your own ultimate army and sortie onto the battlefield!
